tool.name: spoligotyper
tool.description: in silico spoligotyping, species and lineage of the M. tuberculosis complex
tool.command: #import re #if $input.type == 'single' #set $default_name = str($input.single.element_identifier) #else #set $default_name = str($input.pair.name) #end if ## The file type (fasta or fastq, gzipped or not) is detected from the content, not from the name #set $name = re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9._-]', '_', str($sample_name) or re.sub(r'\.(fastq|fq|fasta|fa|fna|fas)(\.gz)?$', '', $default_name)) or 'sample' spoligotyper #if $input.type == 'single' -r1 '$input.single' #else -r1 '$input.pair.forward' -r2 '$input.pair.reverse' #end if --sample '$name' --output results --threads \${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1} --memory \$((\${GALAXY_MEMORY_MB:-2048} * 8 / 10))m #if $min_count --min-count $min_count #end if $no_species #if str($operator) --operator '$operator' #end if > /dev/null && mv results/*_spoligotyping.txt '$table' && mv results/*_spoligotyping.json '$json' && mv results/*_spoligotyping.pdf '$pdf'

param.label: Minimum number of reads to call a spacer present
Skip the species check and the lineage
param.help: Faster: one pass over the reads instead of two

param.label: Operator name, shown in the PDF report

tool.help:
**What it does**
spoligotyper finds the 43 spacers of the direct repeat (DR) locus of *Mycobacterium tuberculosis* complex (MTBC) samples in sequencing reads (fastq) or assemblies (fasta), and reports the spoligotype as binary, octal and hexadecimal codes, and as an SB number from the Mbovis.org database. It also checks the species from regions of difference (RD1, RD4, RD7, RD9, RD12), calls the lineage with the SNP barcode of Coll et al. (2014), estimates the fraction of MTBC reads, and flags mixed or contaminated samples.
**Outputs**
* **Table**: the spoligotype, species, lineage, status and warnings. * **PDF report**: results, the reads supporting each call, input files, software versions and parameters, for quality assurance. * **JSON**: all the results and run information.
**More information**: https://github.com/duceppemo/spoligotyper/wiki
